policy: V22 separates gross period profit from remaining distributable budget and adds a current closed-state capacity gate. distribution.capacity-replay/v1 remains immutable historical/one-shot measurement; after canonical owner-distribution or settlement-reversal entries change the ledger, later payout planning must use distribution.available-capacity/v2 derived from remaining canonical budget plus current closed HardNAV/liquidity.

additions.authority_note: Ledger-derived remaining distribution entitlement for one affected accounting period. Gross period budget is reduced only by canonical OWNER_DISTRIBUTION postings and restored only by canonically posted exact settlement reversals traced to their original payout entry. Authorization or settlement intent alone does not consume or restore budget.

Evidence-bound 1w/4w/8w liquid resources tied to one exact current FinancialSnapshot v2 and AccountingClose v2. Horizon resources cannot exceed the closed-snapshot liquid haircut asset ceiling reconstructed as LiquidNAV + external liabilities.

Non-authorizing current payout ceiling = min(remaining period profit budget, current closed HardNAV solvency headroom, current post-distribution 1w/4w/8w liquidity headroom). Current ReportingLedger/BudgetState/Snapshot/AccountingClose, resource evidence and reconstructed maturity outflows must all be congruent.
